objectives.description: Build scratch copy of state.json with candidate edge applied
Invoke validate-state.sh --deep against scratch, capture output
Grep for cycle line, refuse on match, proceed on no match
Fail-closed guard if validate-state.sh missing/not executable
Header-comment rationale paragraph for write-time placement
Confirm scratch copy needs no sibling archive/state.json

deviations.description: Phase 4 was implemented in the same edit pass as Phase 3 and committed together with it
deviations.reason: The write-time cycle refusal and the write path it guards are inseparable in practice -- an uncommitted intermediate state with a write-capable, cycle-unchecked flag is itself hazardous. Both phases' task checklists and verification were still executed in full; only the commit boundary was merged.
